title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
We are recruiting an experienced Purchase Ledger Clerk for an innovative global leader based at the office in Rotherham.
- Competitive salary + hybrid working + option to buy/sell holidays + additional generous benefits.
- Learning and career development opportunities.
- A company that is building diverse and inclusive teams across the business.
- Enabling individuals to shape their careers in alignment with their personal goals and the company's vision.
- Strong focus on sustainability.

The purpose of the Purchase Ledger Clerk is to support the accurate and timely process of supplier invoices whilst contributing to the financial integrity and operational efficiency of the business.

Reporting to the Finance Manager, duties will include:
- Batching, coding and inputting invoices onto the system.
- Ensuring all invoices are authorised for payment.
- Assisting with month-end reporting.
- Ensuring suppliers are paid according to terms.
- Dealing with queries.
- Liaising with internal staff and suppliers to resolve issues.
- Other ad hoc duties as required.

The person:
- Purchase Ledger experience is essential.
- Strong organisational skills, along with good attention to detail required.
- The successful candidate will be able to work under pressure, in a fast-paced environment, and meet deadlines.
- Good written and verbal communication skills are essential.

title: Receptionist
location: Rotherham, S63 9EH, Thurnscoe, s63 0LT, BARNSLEY, S72 0EJ
description: As a receptionist you will be the first port of call for the practice and first impressions count. It is important that our patients get the the best patient experience when contacting or visiting the practice. The hours we are looking for are 27.5 hours per week as below: Monday 8am - 12 Noon Tuesday Day off Wednesday 8am - 12 Noon Thursday 8am - 6pm Friday 8am - 6.30pm Meeting and greeting patients on reception and helping with the enquiries. Booking of appointments and managing the appointment system. Answering the phones, assisting our patients with requests and sign posting them to the most appropriate service. Admin duties which require attention to detail and accuracy. Maintaining patient confidentiality and accurate record keeping. Admin tasks such as scanning on clinical documents, filing, word processing, handling test results, writing emails, taking messages for your team. Adhering to practice policies and procedures In brief this includes: * Answering the telephone and dealing with patients queries * Booking and arriving patients in for their appointments with healthcare professionals * Unlocking and preparing clinical rooms and ensuring they are stocked * Support the day to day running of the practice in general * Deal with people wishing to register with the practice * Scan on hospital/clinic letters for patients and attach to medical records to ensure records are kept up to date * Deal with medication requests and prescriptions
